name: When should I schedule a roof repair consultation?

mainEntity.name: When should I schedule a roof repair consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should schedule a roof repair consultation as soon as you notice signs of damage, such as missing or cracked shingles, leaks, granules in gutters, or after a severe storm. Addressing issues promptly can prevent minor problems from escalating into more extensive and costly repairs. For example, the intense hailstorms common in the Dallas-Fort Worth area can cause unseen damage that worsens over time if not inspected quickly. Early detection and intervention can significantly save on long-term costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule a consultation immediately after noticing damage like leaks or missing shingles, or following severe weather.
